entries.english: Ordinances and regulations. Date range: 1554–1557, 1601, 1621–1670, 1720–1723. Contains, among other items: 1. Ordinance of Zaisolf von Rosenberg zu Haltenbergstetten on how his subjects are to conduct themselves in spiritual and secular matters, 1554 (1678); 2. police ordinance of Albrecht von Rosenberg zu Boxberg, 1557; 3. revised church and marriage ordinance, 1601; 4. customs ordinance at Niederstetten, 1621 (1635); 5. court protocol at Niederstetten, 1660; 6. police ordinance of the Teutonic Order, 1668; 7. ordinance on weddings and baptisms, 1670; 8. ordinance of the common bailiff's court, (1670); 9. list of the poor in the lordship of Haltenbergstetten, 1724. Extent: 1 file.
